TCP::proxybuffer
       Sets proxy buffer low and high thresholds.

SYNOPSIS
       TCP::proxybuffer ('auto' | (LOW HIGH))

DESCRIPTION
       Sets thresholds at which the proxy buffer accepts (low) and stops accepting (high) new data, in bytes.

       Syntax

       TCP::proxybuffer  

RETURN VALUE
       None.

VALID DURING
       SERVER_INIT, SERVER_CONNECTED, SERVER_DATA

EXAMPLES
	when SERVER_CONNECTED {
	    TCP::proxybuffer 100000 500000
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.
